_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 73 windows moving ±2+ points and the analyst's 0-for-6 directional record in this regime, HOLD with high conviction is the skilled call — no breaker has been identified by either brain.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD while the narrative implies an upward resolution; the judge sides with the analyst based on higher trust weight and the crushing coil base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.001% with exchange reserves falling and stablecoin growth turning positive — signaling actual accumulation
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 80 with DXY strengthening through 101 and BTC loses $60K — forcing a Panic leg down, or fed_liquidity jumps above 30 with ETF flows recovering above 60 — forcing a Hope leg up
